items.html: Explanation: when the Shechina was banished and descended below, to be "a head of foxes" (rosh le-shu'alim) — being in these three worlds called BYA — behold, the inner garment, which is the inner ten Sefirot of the Nukva of ZA of Atzilut, descended and entered and was clothed within the ten Sefirot of Beria, and it became a Neshama to them, to the ten Sefirot of the Nukva of Beria. And her middle ten Sefirot descended and were clothed within the ten Sefirot of the Nukva of ZA of Yetzira. And the outer garment, which is her ten posterior Sefirot, descended and was clothed within the ten Sefirot of the Nukva of Assiya, and became a Neshama to them. And afterward there are the aspects of spirits (Ruchin) and souls (Nefashin), as will be stated, with God's help.
